text:
Sara B: Heads-up — starting bring-up for a new eu-north1 inference cluster for the enterprise pilot. We need to lock GPU capacity (A100 80GB) for initial 3-week benchmarking and canary traffic. Raising a quota + capacity reservation request now. Can infra ops triage tomorrow AM? Target bootstrap Wed.

Matt P: SGTM. What exact capacity are you asking for (GPUs per node / total GPUs)? Any rough cost estimate we should attach to the request?

Sara B: Target is 24 x A100-80GB (6 nodes × 4 GPUs). Requesting a COLO-style capacity reservation in eu-north1 for 2026-04-01 → 2026-04-21 to cover bring-up and load tests. Expected steady-state utilization ~60% during test window. Ballpark committed pricing puts this at ~$13k/week.

Sara B: Quota request template I'm going to submit to GCP account team (paste into ticket):
```
project: redwood-inference-prod
region: europe-north1
requested_gpus: 24
gpu_type: a100-80gb
start_date: 2026-04-01
end_date: 2026-04-21
justification: Enterprise pilot - cluster bring-up, validation, canary traffic. Requires reservation to avoid spot preemption and ensure SLA during onboarding.
billing_tag: team:inference-pilot
contact: sara@redwood.com
```

Li Chen: Two network things: do we have a free /22 in the eu-north1 VPC for node subnets? Also need to confirm that our interconnect / Cloud NAT rules have headroom for the control-plane egress during image pulls (we saw 6 Gbps spikes on last bring-up). I can check IP pool later today.

Ash K: Once quota is approved I can create the reservation. Steps for reference:
1) gcloud compute reservations create inference-res-eun1 --project=redwood-inference-prod --region=europe-north1 --specific-reservation --accelerator-type=a100-80gb --accelerator-count=24 --vm-count=6
2) tag nodes with billing labels + taints for canary/production
3) create instance group manager for bootstrap image

Devops-bot: Autoscaling & batching template added to operations repo: https://git.internal/ops/inference/reservations. Snippet:
```
autoscaling:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 6
  metric: token_throughput
  target: 70%
```

Matt P: Also we should include a fallback path in case quota gets delayed: plan A (full 24 A100s reservation), plan B (12 A100s reserved + overflow to hosted instances for peak tests), plan C (reduce node count and extend test window). Put that in the ticket so the account team can propose alternatives without blocking.

Finance Approver: Provisionally approved spend up to $40k/mo for the pilot (contingent on weekly check-ins and tagging for cost center). Please make sure all resources use billing tag `team:inference-pilot`.

Oncall-bot: Reservation checklist created: /ops/checklists/eun1-reservation.md. Items: quota ticket, network validation, reservation creation, bootstrap IGM, smoke test, canary route. Assigned to: Li Chen, Ash K.

Sara B: Thanks — I'll open the ticket with the request payload and attach the fallback plans + cost estimate. Assigning Li Chen for network validation and Ash K for reservation and bootstrap. Will ping here when GCP confirms quota or if we need to adjust timeline.

Matt P: thx — please ping the account rep and paste the ticket link here so SRE can monitor. :thumbsup:
